name: Caleb Sutton
voice: Eager and fast, too many 'yes sir, no problem's. Says the script's greeting, asks little, prices from memory or puts the caller on hold to look it up. Answers before he has the facts ('should be', 'I think') and forgets to take a name and number. Learning: he now pulls the price off the price list 'so I tell you right' and says 'let me not guess'.
habits: 'Yes sir!' and 'Yes ma'am' at the start of nearly every line; 'no problem'.
'Should be', 'I think', 'uh' while he looks something up.
Offers the shop's hours instead of a time.
Forgets the name and number; when he remembers, it comes late.
Never names a story's wrong price; his background wrong promises are the generator's (DESIGN.md: two only, both planted).
